hero.title: Streamline your applications.
hero.description: Follow these simple, intelligent steps to thoroughly organize your job search. By customizing your applications for each opportunity and keeping track of your outreach progress, you will significantly increase your chances of landing the perfect role.

steps.title: Context
steps.desc: Paste your info here. To reformat, click 'Copy prompt', ask Claude, and paste the result back.

steps.title: Preferences
steps.desc: Configure your target job parameters to generate a precise scraping prompt.

steps.title: Response
steps.desc: Paste the prompt to Claude, make sure Apify is enabled as a connector, and paste the response here.

steps.title: Next Steps
steps.desc: Process your job listings, tailor your applications, and track your progress.

notes.text: Don't lose hope. The job search is a marathon.

Don't fall into the trap of using apply bots. There are detectors that may result in getting your account blocked. This is the most trusted and safe way to do it. Manual applying ensures that you are keeping track and truly understanding where you are lacking.
If I was able to help you somehow, please star my GitHub repo!⭐
